security_spec.violation_condition: In the FreeBSD kernel, any code that reads the ssp CSR (0x011) to capture a thread's shadow-stack state—during cpu_switch(), savectx(), sendsig(), fork(), or ptrace—without first issuing a FENCE w,w (or stronger) to ensure that all prior SSPUSH/C.SSPUSH shadow-stack stores from the outgoing hart are globally visible. Because the spec now explicitly states ssp decrement and the shadow-stack store are unordered with respect to each other, ssp may be observed as already decremented while the corresponding store to [ssp] has not yet completed, exposing stale/garbage data when the thread resumes on a different hart or when the kernel reads shadow-stack memory.
security_spec.summary: SSPUSH ssp-decrement and shadow-stack store now explicitly unordered; kernel must fence before reading ssp for cross-hart context save, or resume sees stale shadow-stack contents

findings.finding: No CSR_SSP (0x011) definition exists in the RISC-V encoding header. The Zicfiss shadow-stack CSR is not registered in the kernel's CSR namespace, meaning no kernel code can reference it.
findings.snippet:
#define CSR_FFLAGS 0x1
#define CSR_FRM 0x2
#define CSR_FCSR 0x3
/* ... no 0x011 entry ... */
#define CSR_SSTATUS 0x100

findings.finding: The RISC-V struct pcb has no field for shadow-stack state (ssp CSR). It only tracks ra, sp, gp, tp, s0-s11, FP registers, fpcsr, fpflags, and onfault. No shadow-stack context is saved/restored across context switches because Zicfiss is not supported.
cpu_switch() saves/restores only ra, sp, s0-s11, and optionally FP state. No ssp CSR is read or written. Since Zicfiss is not supported, the FENCE w,w ordering issue for ssp reads is not applicable.
findings.snippet:
sd ra, (PCB_RA)(x13)
sd sp, (PCB_SP)(x13)
sd s0, (PCB_S + 0*8)(x13)
...
ld ra, (PCB_RA)(x13)
ld sp, (PCB_SP)(x13)

findings.finding: cpu_throw() restores only ra, sp, s0-s11, and optionally FP state from the new thread's pcb. No ssp CSR is written.
findings.snippet:
ld ra, (PCB_RA)(x13)
ld sp, (PCB_SP)(x13)
ld s0, (PCB_S + 0*8)(x13)
...

findings.finding: savectx() stores only ra, sp, tp, gp, s0-s11, and FP state. No ssp CSR is read. The FENCE w,w ordering concern does not apply.
findings.snippet:
sd ra, (PCB_RA)(a0)
sd sp, (PCB_SP)(a0)
sd tp, (PCB_TP)(a0)
sd gp, (PCB_GP)(a0)
sd s0, (PCB_S + 0*8)(a0)
...

findings.finding: sendsig() populates a sigframe using get_mcontext() and sets up the trapframe for signal delivery. No ssp CSR is read or written. Shadow-stack state is not part of the signal frame.
get_mcontext() copies only gpregs (t, s, a, ra, sp, gp, tp, sepc, sstatus) and fpregs to the mcontext. No shadow-stack register is captured.
set_mcontext() restores only gpregs and fpregs from mcontext back to the trapframe/pcb. No ssp CSR is written.

cpu_fork() copies the parent's pcb and trapframe to the child. Since neither struct contains shadow-stack state (no Zicfiss support), no ssp CSR is read. The FENCE w,w ordering concern is not applicable.
The RISC-V ptrace support is minimal (only ptrace_set_pc, ptrace_single_step stub, ptrace_clear_single_step stub). No shadow-stack register is read or written.
locore.S has no references to ssp, 0x011, zicfiss, menvcfg, senvcfg, envcfg, or shadow-stack. The boot sequence does not configure any Zicfiss-related features.
trap.c has no references to ssp, shadow-stack, or Zicfiss. Interrupt/trap handling does not interact with shadow-stack state.
The RISC-V vmm (bhyve) directory has no references to ssp, shadow-stack, or Zicfiss. The hypervisor does not virtualize shadow-stack CSRs for guests.
